content.short: Solidity Auditor is listed here as a Web3 legal and compliance advisory partner for crypto, token, and launch work.
content.description: Solidity Auditor points to Legal Kornet, a law firm focused on crypto, fintech, blockchain, and digital business matters rather than a pure smart contract audit shop. Its official site emphasizes token structuring, licensing, intellectual property, GDPR, AI compliance, and broader legal support for blockchain projects operating across jurisdictions. In practice, this makes the listing more relevant as an advisory resource for launch readiness, regulatory planning, and legal risk review that can sit alongside technical security work.
content.meta: Solidity Auditor, via Legal Kornet, supports crypto teams with token structuring, licensing, compliance, and launch advisory services.
